Dark gray and purple appearance, with matching light mode.

- **System** is the default appearance and follows your operating system, including changes while the app is open.
- Use **Theme** to choose **Dark** or **Light**. Your choice is saved for the next launch.
- Updated app icon, screenshots, and keyboard focus colors.
- The lyrics fix, one-time startup check, Undo, and optional private reports work as before.

Downloads:

- **Classic-Lyrics-Setup-1.0.3.exe** — Windows 10/11 x64. Install this for automatic startup.
- **Classic-Lyrics-Portable-1.0.3.exe** — Windows x64, one-time use without installation.
- **Classic-Lyrics-1.0.3-macOS-Universal.dmg** — macOS 13+, Intel and Apple silicon. Open it and drag the app to Applications.

Windows builds are unsigned. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized, so the operating system may show a publisher/security warning. SHA-256 checksums are included.

Windows and macOS builds run appearance, contrast, repair/undo, startup, report-privacy, consent, packaged-native-module, and renderer-flow tests. The setting's visible effect was verified on Spotify for Windows 1.3.6.1921; it has not been visually verified on a live Mac Spotify installation. Spotify must continue to support the underlying layout flag.
